newsitem.title: OMAN: Sultan of Oman appoints new ministers.
newsitem.headline: Sultan of Oman appoints new ministers.

text.p: Sultan Qaboos bin Said on Tuesday appointed a new minister for defence affairs and a new interior minister, the official Oman News Agency (ONA) reported.
Badr bin Saud bin Hareb al-Bousaidi, previously interior minister, has been appointed Minister in charge of Defence Affairs, ONA said, quoting a decree.
The move follows the death on Saturday of Deputy Prime Minister for Security and Defence Affairs Fahr bin Taimour al-Said, an uncle of the sultan.
Sultan Qaboos is Minister of Defence.
Ali bin Hamoud bin Ali al-Bousaidi has been given the interior portfolio.
